summary: TELUS Corporation filed a Form 6-K furnishing a press release dated November 6, 2026, declaring a routine quarterly cash dividend of CAD $0.1875 per common share, payable January 4, 2027 to holders of record at the close of business on December 11, 2026. The board declared the dividend; no advisor, premium, stake, or structural mechanics are disclosed. This is an ordinary capital-return notice rather than a special situation, so no deal terms apply and there is no risk-arbitrage angle to monitor.
